create_RayParam: create a RayParam module from config to transform rays using the specified parameterization function
build_TwoPlaneParam: build a TwoPlaneParam module that projects rays onto near and far axis-aligned planes
use_PlueckerParam: use PlueckerParam to encode rays as normalized direction and moment vectors for coordinate-invariant representation
create_ContractPointsParam: create a ContractPointsParam module that applies spatial contraction to a subset of parameterized ray channels
use_ray_param_dict: use ray_param_dict to look up and instantiate any registered ray parameterization by name from config
